legend: An experiment at the Large Hadron Collider is being set up to test phase properties of various different particles. There are N%%ZSMJ0%% filters arranged in a circle, where the i%%ZSMJ1%%-th filter allows particles with a phase less than or equal to its limit Ai%%ZSMJ2%% to pass.

An experiment begins with the release of a particle at the position of the i%%ZSMJ3%%-th filter, with an initial phase set to Ai%%ZSMJ4%%. When passing through filter i%%ZSMJ5%%, including the first one, the particle:
Is filtered out if the phase of the particle is greater than the limit Ai%%ZSMJ6%%, ending the experiment.
Otherwise, the particle passes through the filter, increases its phase by K%%ZSMJ7%%, and moves to the next filter on the right, the (imod%%ZSMJ8%%-th filter.

We want to simulate the result of this experiment to compare with the results verified empirically. To achieve this, we need to create a vector B_i%%ZSMJ9%% of size N%%ZSMJ10%%, where B_i%%ZSMJ11%% (1 \leq B_i \leq N%%ZSMJ12%%) is the position of the filter that stopped the particle that started at position i%%ZSMJ13%%.
input: The first line contains two integers N%%ZSMJ14%% (1 \leq N \leq 2 \cdot 10^5%%ZSMJ15%%) and K%%ZSMJ16%% (1 \leq K \leq 10^9%%ZSMJ17%%). The second line contains N%%ZSMJ18%% integers A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_N%%ZSMJ19%% (-10^9 \leq A_i \leq 10^9%%ZSMJ20%%).
output: Print a line containing N%%ZSMJ21%% integers B_1, B_2, \ldots, B_N%%ZSMJ22%%.
